title: Conductor
content: A conductor is a substance which conducts or allows the passage of electricity.

title: Electrolyte
content: An electrolyte is a substance in the molten state or as a solution in water, which allows the passage of electricity.

title: Electrolysis
content: Electrolysis is the decomposition of a compound, in solution or in the molten state, brought about by the passage of an electric current through it.

title: Cathode
content: Cathode is a negative electrode and donates electrons.

title: Anode
content: An anode is a positive electrode and accepts electrons.

title: Electrochemical Cell
content: An electrochemical cell is a device that converts chemical energy into electrical energy or vice versa when a chemical reaction occurs by electrical energy.

title: Electroplating
content: Electroplating is a process to coat one metal with a thin layer of another metal by electrolysis.
